osc1: Core oscillator 1. Pick a waveform and tune FREQ; AMP sets its level, VOICES/DETUNE add unison thickness, and FB adds self-FM feedback (sine morphs toward sawtooth, then into gritty inharmonic tones).
osc2: Core oscillator 2. Same controls as OSC 1 — waveform, FREQ, AMP, VOICES/DETUNE unison, and FB self-FM feedback. Defaults one octave above OSC 1.
osc3: Core oscillator 3. Same controls as OSC 1 — waveform, FREQ, AMP, VOICES/DETUNE unison, and FB self-FM feedback. Defaults one octave below OSC 1.
mixmode: Cross-modulates two selectable oscillators (SRC A / SRC B): RingMod multiplies them, FM lets A modulate B's pitch. When disabled, the oscillators are simply added together.
sub: A sine or square sub-oscillator that tracks OSC 1's pitch one or two octaves down, adding low-end weight.
noise: A white- or pink-noise layer, useful for percussion, breath and texture.
stringkarplus: A plucked-string physical model. PLUCK (or the spacebar) excites the string; DAMP and STR (stretch) shape how its overtones decay.
wavetable: Scans through a wavetable bank; POS morphs the waveform, FREQ/AMP set pitch and level, VOICES/DETUNE add unison. LOAD WAV imports your own wavetable.
envelopeadsr: Shapes each note's amplitude over time: Attack, Decay, Sustain, Release. When disabled, notes play at a flat, un-enveloped level.
lfo: A low-frequency oscillator that modulates a chosen TARGET (pitch, amplitude or filter cutoff) at a set RATE and DEPTH. Modulated knobs show a live ring.
arpeggiator: Turns a held chord into a rhythmic note sequence: MODE sets the direction, RATE the speed, OCT the octave range, GATE the note length.
filter: A low-pass or high-pass filter with resonance. The CUTOFF knob shows a modulation ring when the LFO targets the filter cutoff.
distortion: Adds harmonic grit via soft-clip, hard-clip or foldback. DRIVE sets the intensity, MIX blends against the dry signal.
wavefold: West-coast wavefolding: folds the signal back on itself for bright, metallic harmonics. DRIVE folds harder, SYM offsets the fold, MIX blends.
bitcrush: Lo-fi degradation: BITS reduces bit depth and RATE downsamples for crunchy, digital artefacts. MIX blends against the clean signal.
chorus: Thickens the sound with a modulated, detuned copy. RATE and DEPTH set the movement, MIX the amount.
delay: An echo effect. TIME sets the delay length, FB (feedback) the number of repeats, MIX the wet level.
reverb: Adds a sense of space. ROOM sets the size, DAMP tames the high frequencies, MIX the wet level.
stereo: A pseudo-stereo widener for the mono engine. WIDTH sets the spread, TIME the short delay that creates it.
master: The final output level of the synth.
oscilloscope: A live oscilloscope showing the output waveform over time; the time-base is selectable.
spectrum: A live frequency-spectrum view of the output, with frequency and level scales.
